newsitem.title: USA: City National acquires Ventura County Natl.
newsitem.headline: City National acquires Ventura County Natl.

text.p: City National Corp, parent of City National Bank, said it has signed an agreement to acquire Ventura County National Bancorp in a $47 million deal.

Ventura Country National shareholders will receive either cash or cash and City National stock valued at $5.03 per Ventura County National share. The maximum amount of stock any shareholder can receive is 55 percent of the total.
The price represents a multiple of 1.6 times Ventura County's book value at June 30. The deal is expected to accrete immediately to City National's 1997 earnings.
Ventura County National is the holding company for Ventura County National Bank, an independent bank in Ventura County, Calif., and Frontier Bank NA, which is based in Orange County.
The company had six branches with 129 employees and roughly $274 million in assets as of June 30, 1996.
City National also increases its presence in Los Angeles and Orange counties via Frontier Bank NA.
City National plans to keep all six Ventura County National branches open after completing the deal, which is expected in 1997's first quarter.
